title: 30-second K-pop PERFORMANCE music video, one continuous edited sequence, 16:9…
content:
30-second K-pop PERFORMANCE music video, one continuous edited sequence, 16:9. Cinematic, photoreal live-action, shot on 35mm film. Four Korean women singing direct to lens with accurate lip-sync throughout, plus sharp synchronized choreography and short sport cut-ins.

REFERENCES — hold exactly, do not restyle:
Characters: Woman A @ Image1, Woman B @ Image2, Woman C @ Image3, Woman D @ Image4.
Wardrobe: couture sportswear @ Image5–@ Image8, locked to each character.
Locations: running track @ Image9, boxing gym @ Image10, clay tennis court @ Image11, football pitch @ Image12, concrete changing room @ Image13. Grade @ Image14.
Preserve faces, hair, wardrobe, locations and grade across every cut.

ANATOMY: consistent faces and hair, correct five-fingered hands, stable limbs, natural mouth shapes on the lip-sync. Frame hands via glove, racket grip and footwork where possible.

FRAMING (16:9): compose vertically. Singing close-ups sit high in frame with headroom-to-chin for sharp mouths; low-angle choreo and sport shots hold the full standing figure. Keep formation moves centred so all four read inside the tighter 16:9 width.

CAMERA — two modes, never mixed in one shot:
SINGING shots are STABLE for sharp mouths: locked frame or slow push in, eye-level and low angle, 85mm close-ups.
DANCE and SPORT cut-ins are KINETIC: fast whip-pan, snap zoom, quick lateral track, 35mm/50mm. One clear move per shot, cut on the beat. 24fps natural blur.

GRADE: flat soft overcast light, bright and open, no direct sun, no hard shadows, no rim light. Cool blue-grey palette, cool white balance no amber. Blacks deep not crushed, tinted cool blue; shadows cool grey-blue; flat midtones gentle S-curve; highlights rolled off soft. Skin neutral-cool and pale, warmth only in lips and cheeks. Low saturation with ONE saturated colour hit per shot.

TEXTURE: heavy organic photochemical grain, denser in shadows finer in highlights; emulsion scratches and drifting dust; soft halation on brightest highlights; thin horizontal anamorphic flare off edge speculars; corner chromatic aberration; fast-glass vignetting; faint gate weave. Never clean digital.

TIMESTAMP EDIT (cut on the beat, ~128 BPM):
0–4s INTRO sparse: Woman A singing to lens in the changing room, locked slow push, red wrap; Woman B singing the pickup on the track, locked low angle.
4–8s DROP: all four whip-pan into a hard synchronized arm move on the track; snap-zoom sport cut-in of Woman C punching the bag; slow push on Woman D singing to lens, clay court.
8–14s VERSE: Woman C singing locked in the gym; whip snap-zoom of Woman D striking a tennis ball; lateral track of all four doing hip drops on the pitch; slow push on Woman A singing the line into the hook.
14–20s CHANT HOOK, all four chant to lens "Lace it up, lights on, let's go, get active, get active": whip-pan into a synchronized point move on the track (signature); snap zoom of Woman A controlling the football; lateral track through a formation change; locked close-ups of Women B and C chanting "get active".
20–24s BREAKDOWN, quiet: Woman B singing softly with faint drift in the changing room, heavy grain, breath visible; Woman D standing on the clay, dust settling, mouthing the pre-drop line.
24–30s FINAL DROP, hardest cutting: all four whip-pan into the biggest sync hit chanting "get active"; rapid sport double, Woman C punch then Woman B sprint; slow push settling on all four singing the final "get active" to lens, hold the final frame as audio cuts, grain settling.

AUDIO: female K-pop dance track, English lyrics, hard four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated snare, cold synth stabs, distorted 808 bass, sparse metallic percussion, chanted group hook, confident and aggressive not cute, ~128 BPM. Hook, chanted and repeated: "Lace it up, lights on, let's go, get active, get active." Layer low diegetic sport sound: glove on bag, ball strike, spikes, breath.

Photoreal live-action, visible pores and real skin, practical light, real film grain, no beauty smoothing, no CGI gloss, no on-screen text or logos.

30초 분량의 K-pop PERFORMANCE 뮤직비디오, 하나의 연속 편집 시퀀스, 16:9. 시네마틱, 포토리얼 라이브액션, 35mm 필름 촬영. 네 명의 한국인 여성이 정확한 립싱크로 카메라 렌즈를 직접 보며 노래하고, 선명하게 맞춰진 안무와 짧은 스포츠 컷인이 포함됨.

REFERENCES — 그대로 유지, 스타일 변경 금지:
Characters: Woman A @ Image1, Woman B @ Image2, Woman C @ Image3, Woman D @ Image4.
Wardrobe: couture sportswear @ Image5–@ Image8, 각 캐릭터에 고정.
Locations: running track @ Image9, boxing gym @ Image10, clay tennis court @ Image11, football pitch @ Image12, concrete changing room @ Image13. Grade @ Image14.
모든 컷에서 얼굴, 헤어, 의상, 장소, 그레이드를 유지할 것.

ANATOMY: 일관된 얼굴과 헤어, 정확한 다섯 손가락 손, 안정적인 팔다리, 립싱크에 맞는 자연스러운 입 모양. 가능하면 장갑, 라켓 그립, 풋워크로 손을 프레이밍할 것.

FRAMING (16:9): 세로 구도로 구성. 노래 클로즈업은 프레임 상단에 배치하고, 머리 위 여백부터 턱까지 확보해 입 모양이 선명하게 보이도록 할 것; 로우앵글 안무와 스포츠 샷은 서 있는 전신을 모두 담을 것. 포메이션 동작은 중앙에 두어, 더 좁은 16:9 폭 안에서도 네 명 모두가 읽히도록 유지할 것.

CAMERA — 두 가지 모드, 한 샷 안에서 절대 혼합 금지:
SINGING 샷은 선명한 입 모양을 위해 STABLE: 고정 프레임 또는 느린 푸시인, 아이레벨과 로우앵글, 85mm 클로즈업.
DANCE와 SPORT 컷인은 KINETIC: 빠른 휩팬, 스냅 줌, 짧은 측면 트래킹, 35mm/50mm. 샷당 하나의 명확한 움직임만 사용하고, 비트에 맞춰 컷. 24fps의 자연스러운 모션 블러.

GRADE: 평평하고 부드러운 흐린 날빛, 밝고 개방적인 느낌, 직사광선 없음, 강한 그림자 없음, 림라이트 없음. 쿨 블루-그레이 팔레트, 앰버 기운 없는 쿨 화이트 밸런스. 블랙은 깊되 뭉개지지 않게, 쿨 블루 톤으로 물들 것; 그림자는 쿨 그레이-블루; 평평한 미드톤은 부드러운 S-커브; 하이라이트는 부드럽게 롤오프. 피부는 뉴트럴-쿨하고 창백하게, 따뜻함은 입술과 볼에만. 채도는 낮게 유지하되, 샷마다 하나의 강한 포인트 컬러만 허용.

TEXTURE: 두껍고 유기적인 포토케미컬 그레인, 그림자에서는 더 촘촘하고 하이라이트에서는 더 미세하게; 에멀전 스크래치와 떠다니는 먼지; 가장 밝은 하이라이트에 부드러운 할레이션; 가장자리 스페큘러에서 얇은 수평 아나모픽 플레어; 코너 색수차; 빠른 글래스 비네팅; 희미한 게이트 위브. 절대 깨끗한 디지털 느낌 금지.

Hook, chanted and repeated: "Lace it up, lights on, let's go, get active, get active." Layer low diegetic sport sound: glove on bag, ball strike, spikes, breath.

포토리얼 라이브액션, 보이는 모공과 실제 피부, 실용 조명, 실제 필름 그레인, 뷰티 스무딩 없음, CGI 광택 없음, 화면 내 텍스트나 로고 없음.
